sections.heading: Special driving situations — B
sections.markdown:
Audience and scope: special driving situations within the selected first-time passenger-car knowledge preparation path. This is an authoring scope from the pinned run configuration.
Coverage plan: Police traffic stops; Headlights and night driving; Fog; Winter and work zones. These are authored organizational labels, with no official examination weighting or eligibility assertion.
Every extracted police-stop instruction, headlight trigger, night and fog guidance, winter response and work-zone rule is represented. External videos and department links are not additional fact authorities. Weapon notification is identified as handbook advice, and the brake-tapping wording remains source-qualified pending review of its vehicle-system scope.
